title: Wall Mount Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass For Bathroom | Allied Brass
description:
Keep essentials within reach while saving space with this wall mount retractable hooks and garment rod. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then retracts when not in use—ideal for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Retractable design: extends for 2-1/2" hanging space and pushes back in to reduce visual clutter
- Solid brass construction
- Supports up to 15 lb for coats, robes, and towels
- Swap the included knob tip with your own cabinet knob to coordinate with minimalist bathroom fixtures
- Wall mount installation saves floor space

Specs & installation:
- Fits standard interior walls
- Mounting hardware included; uses 6/32 toggles
- Drilling required: 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L; projection 1"
- Multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors

_previous.title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
